title: 新加坡加拿大能源供应链AI合作
titleEn: Singapore and Canada on Energy, Supply Chain, and AI
summary: 新加坡与加拿大深化能源、供应链和AI合作，预计数月内敲定协议。外交部长巴拉克里什南访问渥太华后宣布此消息。
summaryEn: Singapore and Canada are deepening cooperation in energy, supply chains, and AI, with deals expected within months. FM Vivian Balakrishnan announced this after visiting Ottawa.
speaker: Vivian Balakrishnan
